name: streamskope
description: A desktop workbench for exploring and operating event-streaming systems.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config config/vite.config.ts && npm run build:electron
scripts.ci:docs: python3 tools/docs_test.py && npm run docs:build && npm run docs:smoke
scripts.promo:preview: npm run docs:build && npm --prefix website/promo run preview
scripts.promo:render: npm --prefix website/promo run render && npm run docs:build
scripts.package:verify: npm run build && tsx tools/verify-package.ts && npm run test:e2e:package
scripts.package:verify:macos: node tools/verify-native-package-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:verify:windows: node tools/verify-native-package-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:verify:linux: node tools/verify-native-package-target.mjs linux x64 && npm run package:verify
scripts.package:release:verify: npm run build && tsx tools/verify-package.ts --release && npm run test:e2e:package
scripts.test:ui:unit: vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts test/unit/streamskope-workbench-layout.test.tsx test/unit/streamskope-activity-workbench.test.tsx test/unit/streamskope-theme.test.ts test/unit/profile-workflow.test.tsx test/unit/message-presentation.test.tsx test/unit/kafka-message-operations-workflow.test.tsx test/unit/activity-log-drawer.test.tsx test/unit/metric-plot.test.tsx test/unit/kafka-stream-monitor-panel.test.tsx test/unit/kafka-latency-workflow.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p config/typescript/host.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p config/typescript/renderer.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p config/typescript/test.json --noEmit --pretty false && npm run typecheck:packaging
scripts.verify: npm run verify:source && npm run verify:system && npm run verify:native
scripts.verify:source: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:unit && npm run performance:background-work && npm run performance:electron-message-retention && npm run performance:electron-consumer-soak && npm run performance:kafka-live-rules && npm run performance:kafka-message-operations && npm run performance:kafka-stream-tuning && npm run test:integration && npm run dependencies:verify
scripts.verify:system: npm run test:kafka && npm run test:e2e:web && npm run test:e2e:electron
scripts.verify:native: node tools/verify-native-package-target.mjs && npm run test:e2e:boundary && npm run package:verify
scripts.verify:ui:review: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:ui:unit && npm run test:ui:playwright
